title: Variance Reduction & Behavioral Effects
description: Tackle the pitfalls that distort real experiment results: apply CUPED to shrink confidence intervals without collecting more data, detect novelty and primacy effects that inflate short-term lifts, diagnose network interference when users interact with each other, and run subgroup analyses without inflating false positive rates.
outcomes: You'll apply CUPED using a pre-experiment covariate and explain when the technique is invalid, distinguish novelty effects from genuine long-term treatment effects and prescribe a remedy, identify SUTVA violations in social or marketplace experiments and choose between cluster randomization and holdout-based measurement, and conduct subgroup analyses without inflating the family-wise error rate.
